title: spec: a blueprint object cannot carry icon, so a blueprint-built table gets the generic glyph that create_object tells agents to avoid
body:
repo:cloud#4 · os-bob · session_012dn2AdARJtc4RgABPH7PHk

Filing gate: finding from the cloud lane (cloud#4339, PR objectstack-ai/cloud#4409, merged).

## What
`BlueprintObjectSchema` (`packages/spec/src/ai/solution-blueprint.zod.ts`, main ~:348; pin ~:309) declares name, label, description, fields, sharingModel, nameField, stageField — no `icon`, though `ObjectSchema` has one and `create_object`'s tool schema tells agents to ALWAYS set it. `/api/v1/mcp` apply_blueprint with `objects[0].icon` is refused: `carries "icon", which a blueprint object does not declare` (measured on a hosted tenant, cloud#4339 comment 6819231279).

## Expected
`BlueprintObjectSchema` accepts an optional `icon` with the same vocabulary/validation as `ObjectSchema.icon`; cloud's stager then passes it to the staged object and the nav entry. Pin test.

Dedupe words: BlueprintObjectSchema icon, blueprint object icon undeclared. Related: cloud#4339.
